'''The Loft''' was a building that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hestobyll]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byllura]]. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], The Loft served as the residence of the twin [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]], the leaders of the [[Dyarchy]].
